caption: The drawing consists of three separate depictions of pottery objects and one detailed close-up. The central object is a large, tan-colored ceramic jar with two handles near its rounded top, featuring a painted blue floral design with a central flower and leaves on its body. Above to the right, there is a smaller tan-colored jar with two handles, decorated with a blue bird standing to the right. At the bottom left, there is a close-up detail view of one handle from a jar, showing a decorative, circular blue element below the handle where it joins the vessel. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color, and the artist's name, Yolande Delasser, is inscribed at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
